title: Stake Tiers on Steem-Family Chains: Whale, Dolphin, Minnow, and What a Vote Is Worth
provenanceNote: Hand-authored educational seed for the new knowledge/steem-economy/ corpus (Witness School + tutorial draw on it). Article 1 of 3. Covers: staked vs liquid coin; the canonical five tiers plankton/minnow/dolphin/orca/whale with the SteemPlus ~500/5,000/50,000/500,000 SP thresholds (flagged as conventions, not consensus constants); 'redfish' flagged as informal/non-canonical; the core mechanic vote-rshares proportional to stake x mana x weight; the dust threshold (MELEK 50,000,000 rshares) making small votes zero; mana regen (MELEK 5 days) capping spread; delegate_vesting_shares as the tier bridge; and MELEK keeping the energy/mana HUD legible (contrast with Blurt dropping RC). MELEK constants (25% curation, square-root curve, dust=5e7, mana=432000s) cite the project's melek-curation-vote-constants memory (live get_config). HARD compliance: neutral/educational, not-investment-advice, no yield promise, no price prediction. Uncertain facts explicitly flagged.
